item.title: BENJI: About 161.7M BENJI moved from five EVM chains to Stellar in 13 minutes
item.guid: 2026-11-04BENJI: About 161.7M BENJI moved from five EVM chains to Stellar in 13 minutes
item.description: Between 21:47 and 22:00 UTC, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche and Polygon each show two burns of about 16.17M, and Base dropped by the same amount. In the same minutes the Stellar issuer minted ten times, same amounts to the cent, to two accounts. Who and why is not known.
